title: BSB API HTTPie Collection
description: HTTPie collection for the BSB Bible Toolkit API (Cloudflare Worker). Run `npm run dev` in the api/ directory to start wrangler dev on :8787, then use these requests with `http --pretty=all < ./path/to/file.http` or source them via the shell wrappers.

requests.name: health
requests.description: Service status, version, and cache tier availability

requests.name: books
requests.description: Full book catalog (66 books with OSIS codes, names, chapter counts)

requests.name: book
requests.description: Single book metadata by OSIS code (e.g. JHN, GEN, 1CO)

requests.name: chapter
requests.description: Full chapter with all verses, cross-refs, footnotes, and entities

requests.name: verse
requests.description: Single verse by dotted OSIS reference

requests.name: passage
requests.description: Parse a reference (human or OSIS), expand range, fetch all verses. Supports ranges.

requests.name: resolve
requests.description: Accepts ANY input format (human refs, OSIS, Bible app URIs, provider URLs) and returns canonical passage + verse text

requests.name: search
requests.description: Substring search across all verse text

requests.name: crossrefs
requests.description: Cross-references and entity links for a verse. Optional ?source= filter (repeatable).
